en: Two people, as different as can be
Opposites in every single way
Yet somehow, together,
it just feels right
Wait, how is it that everything you do
is a little off-beat? Why on earth?

ko: 남들이 하는 대로 하지, 대체 왜 자꾸 저럴까
en: Why not do what everyone does? Why do you keep doing that?
Everyone is looking at you
Doesn't it bother you? It would bother me

ko: 보든 말든 괜찮나, 아님 일부러 시선을 끌려
en: You don't seem to mind, or maybe you want the attention
and secretly, you enjoy it
I never knew someone so unlike me existed
How can someone, from head to toe,

ko: 다른 사람이 있을까, 정말이지 처음 봤어
en: be so different? I had never seen anyone like you

ko: 그래서 보게 됐지, 놀랐어 정말 신기했어
en: So I kept looking, amazed and fascinated

ko: 나와 다른 게, 그걸 바라보는 게 좋았어
en: How different you are, I loved watching it

ko: 너도 날 바라보면서 그런지, 왜 날 바라보지 어
en: Do you feel the same? Why are you looking at me?
I think I'm falling in love
even though we're so different
Love is such a mystery

ko: 살아가면서 한 번 올까 말까 한 그런 사랑인데
en: the kind of love that comes once in a lifetime, if ever
and I think it has found me
It's not quite what I dreamed of
but we make each other smile

ko: 네 곁에 있으면 자꾸만 행복하단 생각이 들죠
en: Whenever I'm by your side, I can't help but feel happy
I think I'm falling in love
